claim-d08766cc9e6b2feb.claim: N0001: For Lebesgue integrable real f and nonnegative h on R2, measurable uniformly bounded cutoffs chi_n converging to 1 almost everywhere, and C >= 0, if abs(integral f*chi_n) <= C*sqrt(integral over norm(x)>=n of h) for every n, then integral f=0. This general lemma does not assert that the FNS fields satisfy its hypotheses.
